name: @day8/re-frame2-implementor
description: Guides an engineer building a NEW re-frame2 implementation in one of the eight in-scope JS-cross-compile-to-React+VDOM host languages — ClojureScript (the reference), TypeScript, Melange/ReScript/Reason, F# (Fable), Squint, Scala.js, PureScript, Kotlin/JS — over a two-phase workflow (record the port profile, then one EP loop driven by the pinned spec and live conformance fixtures, with the conformance corpus as the acceptance test). A Claude Code Skill, companion to the application-side re-frame2 skills.
